questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 14 cm and a height of 10 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 14 × 10 = 70 cm² — halving is the step that gets skipped when rushing.
